name: Chicago Midway International Airport

runway.v: longest runway 6,522 ft x 150 ft (about 1,988 m), as shown on the runway diagram in the Fly Quiet manual

curfew.v: voluntary nighttime curfew for air carriers 00:00-06:00 local; the manual says nothing about business or charter flights at night
curfew.quote: A Voluntary Air Carrier Nighttime Curfew is in effect at Midway International Airport between the hours of 12:00 a.m.

noise.v: voluntary Fly Quiet Program: expedite climb through 1,500 ft MSL 22:00-06:00, night preferential runways; maintenance run-ups not allowed 22:00-07:00 weeknights and 22:00-09:00 weekends
noise.quote: The Fly Quiet Program is a voluntary program.

notes: Read the Chicago Department of Aviation's Midway Fly Quiet Program Manual 2026 (updated Feb 2026). The diagram lists 6,522, 6,446, 5,507 and 3,859 ft runways without tying each size to a runway number, so only the longest length is recorded; metres are my conversion (1 ft = 0.3048 m). Not opened: CBP KMDW fact sheet (4 Mar 2026) https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2026-03/KMDW%20GA%20Airport%20Fact%20Sheet%2020260304.pdf, the older one (6 May 2024), and the CBP port page https://www.cbp.gov/about/contact/ports/midway-international-airport-chicago-illinois-3910; FAA Chart Supplement (CS_EC_20260903.pdf) not opened. IATA code left null: the official pages read show only the FAA identifier, not a stated IATA code.
